# Badge — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A notification badge that anchors a count or status `Tag` at a configurable corner of any child element — typically used for unread counts on icons or buttons.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below. Use the HTML Skill lookup command with `--id extensions.badge --read-source` to read the source closure.
